concept.title: Validating Fields
concept.shortdesc: Use the Validate action to ensure that all smart fields in your document are in

conbody.p: Use the Validate action to ensure that all smart fields in your document are in the proper format for their assigned data type (e.g., Date, Number, DateTime, selected values from picklists,etc.). The agreement document cannot be reconciled at check-in unless all fields in your document are valid.
